|lore=Necklace worn by Princess Leia during the awards ceremony after the Battle of Yavin. A powerful artifact in the Alderaanian royal family for dozens of generations.
|game_text=Deploy on table. While you have < 13 cards in hand, opponent may not peek at or remove those cards (except with Grimtaash). May lose 2 Force to target two [Coruscant] Political Effects; opponent may not place cards on either until the next time you use this text. (Immune to Alter.)
